summary: The build has been approved and is getting started. We have your Botswana event dates (30 November to 3 December) and your logos. Next we need the date registration opens, and we are starting your WhatsApp approval because it takes time.

phases.name: Guest registration
phases.description: The foundation and the form guests use to register, with their consent.
phases.target: When registration opens (date to be confirmed)

phases.name: Operations dashboard and messaging
phases.description: Your team's control view, plus SMS and WhatsApp messages to guests.
phases.target: Early November, about 3 weeks before the event

phases.name: Check-in on the day
phases.description: Scanning guests in, or finding them by name, on your own phones and iPad, working even without signal.
phases.target: Late November, at the dress rehearsal

whats_next: Confirm the date registration opens, so we can lock in every delivery date
Start the WhatsApp business approval (this has a waiting period outside our control), using your shuttle message wording
Begin Phase A: the registration foundation

needs_from_you.item: The date registration should open, and whether guests have already started registering on the Google Form
needs_from_you.why: Sets our first deadline, and tells us whether to bring existing registrations across

needs_from_you.item: Your iPad's model and software version (Settings, General, About)
needs_from_you.why: So we can confirm it will work for check-in, or plan for it to be used for look-ups
So we can plan a quiet practice run alongside it

needs_from_you.item: Grant's list of the reports you need
needs_from_you.why: So the reports match how you actually work

updates.text: Event dates received: Botswana, 30 November to 3 December, with accreditation on 1, 2 and 3 December. Logos received. Manual check-in by name, without a scan, is planned for the day.
Project approved. Planning complete and the build team is set up. Registration and event setup come first.

change_requests.title: Team photos in guest messages
change_requests.status: Noted for after the December event. In the meantime, messages will name the host (for example, "Your host today is Thandi").
